dimensions.assessment: Affects satellite operators, commercial space companies, federal space agencies, and the public utilizing the space object database.
dimensions.evidence: provide basic space situational awareness services to satellite operators... access for the public, at no charge, to a fully updated, unclassified database

dimensions.assessment: Provides legal immunity from suits related to space data services, reorganizes a federal office into a bureau, and mandates free data sharing.
dimensions.evidence: be immune from any suit in any court for any cause of action arising from the provision or receipt of space situational awareness services

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes data acquisition contracts and administrative reorganization within the Department of Commerce without specifying a total dollar cap.
dimensions.evidence: enter into such contracts, leases, cooperative agreements, or other transactions as may be necessary

dimensions.assessment: Restructures the Office of Space Commerce into a bureau headed by a Senate-confirmed Assistant Secretary and establishes statutory space traffic coordination duties.
dimensions.evidence: elevated by the Secretary of Commerce from an office within the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration to a bureau

dimensions.assessment: Permanent structural elevation of the office and ongoing statutory mandates for data collection, dissemination, and periodic reviews.
dimensions.evidence: not less frequently than every 3 years, shall review the basic space situational awareness services

missing_information: Specific financial costs or budget allocations for transitioning the office to a bureau and acquiring commercial space data.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill elevates the Office of Space Commerce to a standalone bureau, provides statutory authority for space situational awareness and traffic coordination data services, and grants government immunity.
